name: DeveloperSD Logo Slider
author: Sudip Debnath

sections.description:
DeveloperSD Logo Slider is a logo/brand carousel plugin built for professional client sites, powered by the battle-tested Slick Carousel engine (bundled locally – no CDN dependency).

Features

  • Unlimited logo sliders, each with its own logos, order, and settings
  • Drag-and-drop logo reordering in the admin
  • Optional link, target, title, alt text, and custom class per logo
  • Fully configurable responsive breakpoints (Desktop / Tablet / Mobile slide counts)
  • Navigation arrows with selectable icons and icon sizing
  • Per-device arrow and pagination-dot visibility (Desktop / Tablet / Mobile)
  • Pagination dots, autoplay, infinite loop
  • Marquee mode: continuous, seamless, infinite scrolling with smooth pause on hover
  • Touch swipe, mouse drag, and keyboard navigation
  • Respects the visitor’s “prefers-reduced-motion” setting
  • Live, near-real-time preview while editing a slider
  • Duplicate, export (JSON), and import sliders
  • Shortcode output: [developersd_logo_slider id="123"]
  • Optional Elementor widget and Divi module — the core plugin works perfectly without either
  • Assets are only loaded on pages that actually use a slider
  • Built to pass the WordPress Plugin Check tool cleanly

Shortcode

[developersd_logo_slider id="123"]

Optional attribute overrides:

[developersd_logo_slider id="123" autoplay="false" desktop="4" tablet="2" mobile="1" nav="true" dots="false"]

Marquee mode:

[developersd_logo_slider id="123" mode="marquee" marquee_speed="60" marquee_direction="left"]

Developer Notes

See the in-admin Documentation / Help screen for the full list of actions and filters, including developersd_logo_slider_before, developersd_logo_slider_after, developersd_logo_slider_args, developersd_logo_slider_logo_data, developersd_logo_slider_classes, developersd_logo_slider_output, developersd_logo_slider_capability, and developersd_logo_slider_template.

Credits

Built by DeveloperSD. The frontend carousel is powered by Slick Carousel by Ken Wheeler, MIT licensed, bundled locally under assets/vendor/slick/ (only the core script and structural stylesheet – no CDN dependency, and no icon-font theme file, since this plugin supplies its own arrow/dot styling). See assets/vendor/slick/LICENSE and assets/vendor/slick/NOTICE.txt for full attribution. Admin drag-and-drop reordering uses jQuery UI Sortable, which ships with WordPress core.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the developersd-logo-slider folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Logo Slider → Add New Slider.
  4. Add your logos, configure the settings, set Status to Active, and Publish.
  5. Copy the shortcode into any post, page, or widget area.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor or Divi?

No. The core plugin works entirely through the [developersd_logo_slider] shortcode. Elementor and Divi integrations are automatically enabled only if those plugins are already active, and can be turned off from Settings → Advanced.

Will deleting a slider delete my images?

No. Deleting a slider (or uninstalling the plugin, by default) never deletes Media Library attachments — only the slider’s own configuration.

Can I have more than one slider on the same page?

Yes, use as many shortcodes as you like; each slider’s assets are only loaded once per page regardless of how many instances appear.

How do I completely remove all plugin data?

Enable “Delete all plugin data on uninstall” in Settings → Advanced before deleting the plugin from the Plugins screen. This is disabled by default so your data is preserved.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • New: Marquee display mode – a continuous, seamless, infinite scroll with adjustable speed and direction, and a smooth pause on hover/focus.
  • New: Marquee options in the Elementor widget, Divi module, and shortcode (mode, marquee_speed, marquee_direction).

1.1.5

  • Hardened rendered slider HTML across shortcode, Elementor, Divi, preview, and AJAX paths using a restricted WordPress HTML allowlist.

1.1.4

  • Escape rendered slider markup at preview and Elementor output boundaries using a restricted WordPress HTML allowlist.

1.1.3

  • Register Elementor slider assets on the Elementor asset lifecycle.
  • Enforce bounded numeric pixel widths during settings sanitization and rendering.

1.1.3

  • Fixed Elementor asset registration timing to avoid WordPress incorrect-use notices with WP_DEBUG enabled.
  • Restricted Container Max Width to a validated numeric pixel value, preventing CSS declaration injection.

1.1.1

  • Removed per-slider arbitrary Custom CSS input for WordPress.org directory compliance.
  • Replaced direct preview style output with the WordPress inline-style API.
  • Moved the top-level admin menu to a lower, less prominent position.
  • Removed the non-functional sortable Status column declaration.
  • Limited plugin notices to contextual plugin actions and removed the dashboard capability notice.

1.1.0

  • Fixed toggle switch dimensions when labels are stacked below the control.
  • Normalized toggle alignment across settings cards, edit screens, and the slider list table.

1.0.14

  • Improved toggle layout across the plugin admin: status and Enabled/Disabled text now renders below the switch for stable alignment on all screen sizes.
  • Updated Global Settings checkboxes to use the same consistent toggle UI.

1.0.13

  • Clarified the Autoplay & Loop settings with a dedicated Infinite Loop toggle.
  • Infinite Loop works independently with autoplay, arrow navigation, touch swipe, and manual navigation.

1.0.12

  • Removed the attachment meta_key/meta_value lookup used by repeated image migrations.
  • Added a compact source-URL hash index for migrated Media Library attachments to avoid slow post-meta queries.
  • Kept direct attachment validation so stale or mismatched migration index entries are never reused.

1.0.11

  • Fixed Elementor widget asset loading using declared script/style dependencies.
  • Added Elementor live-editor reinitialization support.
  • Fixed Divi module registration and changed Visual Builder support to server-rendered partial compatibility.
  • Removed the Divi module/shortcode slug collision and preserved legacy Divi content compatibility.
  • Improved builder preview feedback when a selected slider is inactive or unavailable.

1.0.10

  • Added portable cross-site logo image migration for both single-slider and Export All JSON files.
  • Same-site imports safely reuse the existing Media Library attachment when its URL matches.
  • Cross-site imports download missing source images into the destination Media Library and remap slider attachment IDs automatically.
  • Re-imports reuse images previously migrated from the same source URL to avoid duplicate Media Library files.
  • Added safer handling for attachment-ID collisions between different WordPress sites and improved partial-import notices when a remote image cannot be fetched.

1.0.9

  • Fixed JSON import on servers where WordPress uses an FTP/SSH filesystem transport and cannot access PHP upload temp files.
  • Added a versioned export format shared by single-slider and Export All downloads.
  • Kept backward compatibility with legacy single-slider and Export All JSON files.
  • Added individual Export JSON buttons to the Settings slider list.
  • Improved import validation and partial-import handling.

1.0.8

  • Kept Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile slide-count controls together in one responsive row.
  • Added a configurable Mobile breakpoint to individual sliders and global defaults.
  • Kept Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile breakpoint controls together in one responsive row.
  • Added breakpoint ordering safeguards and explicit three-breakpoint Slick responsive handling.

1.0.7

  • Unified the admin settings design across General, Navigation, Autoplay & Loop, Interaction, and Logo Display tabs.
  • Added consistent cards, field groups, toggle switches, spacing, units, descriptions, and responsive admin layouts.
  • Improved mobile settings-tab navigation.

1.0.6

  • Fixed pagination dots so they initialize reliably and remain available across responsive breakpoint changes.
  • Added reliable per-device visibility handling for both arrows and dots without forcing Slick to rebuild controls.
  • Added working top/bottom dot placement and inside/outside arrow positioning.
  • Redesigned the Navigation settings tab with clean cards, responsive two-column controls, toggle switches, device pills, and aligned unit fields.

1.0.5

  • Added independent Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile visibility controls for arrow navigation and pagination dots.
  • Added selectable arrow icon styles and a dedicated arrow icon-size control.
  • Fixed arrow glyph centering and constrained oversized icons so they remain inside the navigation button.

1.0.4

  • Fixed remaining WordPress Plugin Check i18n, escaping, naming-convention, and readme warnings.
  • Updated WordPress compatibility metadata to 7.1.

1.0.3

  • Improved input validation and sanitization for saved slider data and AJAX previews.
  • Added stricter uploaded import-file validation.
  • Removed the no-longer-required manual translation loading call for WordPress.org compatibility.
  • Cleaned up Plugin Check security and nonce-analysis warnings.

1.0.2

  • Added Active/Inactive toggle switches to the slider editor and sliders list table.
  • Added AJAX quick status switching from the sliders list table.

1.0.1

  • Fixed frontend and admin Live Preview slider asset initialization.
  • Fixed shortcode meta-box overflow styling.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
